newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha firm on good demand, Skikda shortfall.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha firm on good demand, Skikda shortfall.

text.p: NWE naphtha was firm on Tuesday, with the market supported by good demand for paraffinic grades and the closure of the Skikda oil terminal, traders said.
The closure of port since the middle of last week has already had a knock-on effect, with a French term contract lifter in the market looking for spot material.
Three naphtha liftings have been delayed by the closure of the port which is scheduled to reopen tonight.
Although demand for reforming naphtha is still in the doldrums, cargo prices were assessed firm at quotes cif high +$3/$5, basis Rotterdam.
